semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Power (H.K.) Semiconductor Ltd. provides essential equipment and services for semiconductor assembly and packaging.
summary: Micro-Power (H.K.) Semiconductor Ltd. is a prominent provider of equipment and services tailored for the semiconductor, SMT, and electronic packaging markets. Established in 2002, the company offers a range of solutions including die bonding, dispensing systems, and wire bonding equipment, supported by a strong technical and sales presence across China and Taiwan.

regional_presence.China: MPS has sales offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Suzhou to support local customers.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company also maintains a presence in Taiwan to cater to regional market needs.
